top_signals.title: Ripple CLO says Sept. 15 will be a ‘bellwether’ for Clarity Act market structure bill
top_signals.summary: Stuart Alderoty calls Sept. 15 a key test for the Clarity Act and warns the U.S. could "miss an incredible opportunity."
